_schema.source_note: Profiles sourced from official agency leadership pages. Each profile cites its source URL. Quarterly refresh cadence per PAYWALL-ENRICHMENT.md item 4. Per-person verified_date/verification_note override the block date when a name was last confirmed on an older page pull.

agencies.note: The dha.mil Organizational Structure page (read 2026-10-19, undated) lists six principals: Director, Deputy Director, Command Senior Enlisted Leader and the three Assistant Directors. Everyone else in this block comes from DHA briefings and the Director's 21 SEP 2026 leadership message and carries a per-person date. The OWHA staff entries added 2026-11-08 come from research Mary Womack handed MMT, sourced to the dha.mil CDAO page, DHA-authored DHITS 2026 decks (August 2026, held in MMT's DHITS library), DHA news articles, LinkedIn profiles and OrangeSlices AI; no page was reachable from the session that applied them, so each LinkedIn- or trade-press-sourced entry carries pending official confirmation until a dha.mil or health.mil page names the seat.

people.name: Vice Adm. Darin K. Via, MC, USN
people.title: Director
people.scope: Operates DHA enterprise — MHS GENESIS sustainment, MTF management, military health benefits.
people.why_watch: Reports to ASW(HA). Owns the operational health-IT footprint that contractors deliver against.
people.verification_note: Listed as Director on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page, read 2026-10-19.

people.name: Dr. David J. Smith
people.title: Deputy Director
people.scope: Day-to-day DHA enterprise operations.
people.why_watch: Where the operational decisions on DHMSM sustainment and HCDS task-order execution actually land.
people.verification_note: Listed as Deputy Director on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page, read 2026-10-19.

people.name: Force Master Chief PatrickPaul "PaP" Mangaran
people.title: Command Senior Enlisted Leader
people.scope: Senior enlisted advisor to the DHA Director.
people.why_watch: Voice for the military beneficiary side of MHS GENESIS rollout and clinical-IT usability.
people.verification_note: Listed as Command Senior Enlisted Leader on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page, read 2026-10-19 (the page renders the name as PatrickPaul C. Mangaran).

people.name: Mr. William Walker
people.title: Assistant Director, Healthcare Administration and Operations
people.scope: AD-HCAO portfolio — markets, MTF operations, healthcare ops PMOs. Succeeds Brig. Gen. Bill A. Soliz, who held the seat in an acting capacity from the April 2026 restructuring.
people.why_watch: Per the April 2026 reorg, AD-HCAO oversees one of four IOC PMO clusters. Five PMOs roll up here through FOC. The seat is no longer acting, so a commitment made here holds.
people.verification_note: Listed on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page as Assistant Director, Healthcare Administration and Operations, with no Acting designation, read 2026-10-19. No dha.mil biography is linked and no appointment date is published; background pending official confirmation.

people.name: Dr. Matthew G. Clark
people.title: Assistant Director, Research, Development & Acquisition; Component Acquisition Executive (Confirmed); Senior Procurement Executive (reported)
people.scope: Component Acquisition Executive for DHA: final component-level acquisition authority over medical systems, medical products and medical digital solutions. Named AD-RDA/CAE by the DHA Director on 21 SEP 2026. The Director says he came from command of NATO's Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe Healthcare Facility and the Brussels Army Health Clinic in Belgium, with a career across defense, global public health, science and technology. Mary's OWHA territory map (2026-11-08) cites a DHA article of 04 NOV 2026, "Strengthening acquisition, research efforts will support warfighter readiness", reporting him sworn in on 21 SEP 2026 and naming him Senior Procurement Executive; MMT has not reached that page.
people.why_watch: Every component-level health IT and medical systems buy runs through this seat. It is no longer acting, so a commitment made here holds. He inherits the three portfolio acquisition executives stood up through FOC.
people.verification_note: Listed on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page as Assistant Director, Research, Development & Acquisition/Component Acquisition Executive, read 2026-10-19 (no bio linked). Appointment first carried in the DHA Director leadership message "Key DHA HQ Personnel Updates", VADM Darin K. Via, 21 SEP 2026 (milsuite Leadership Messages; not a public link). Provided to MMT by Mary Womack. Trade press reported the appointment separately (BioBuzz, OrangeSlices AI), rendering his experience as more than 26 years against the Director's 25, so MMT prints no year count. Senior Procurement Executive and swearing-in: DHA article of 04 NOV 2026 (https://www.dha.mil/News/2026/11/04/15/39/Strengthening-acquisition-research-efforts-support-warfighter-readiness) as cited in the territory map Mary provided 2026-11-08; not reached from the session, so carried as reported until read.

people.name: Mr. Brett Scheideman
people.title: Acting Principal Deputy, AD-RDA / Deputy Component Acquisition Executive
people.scope: Principal deputy to the Component Acquisition Executive: S&T, Chief Scientist, Research Support, Industry Engagement, Agreements and Partnerships, Category Management, Acquisition Workforce. Co-chairs the Warfighter Modernization and Support Integration Board with OWHA, the funding gate for new technology; finance attends and a leadership decision takes about two weeks.
people.why_watch: Every OWHA-framed requirement crosses his board before acquisition buys it. He told DHITS 2026 that industry does not know what DHA will buy next year and promised better forecasts, industry days and reverse industry days.
people.verification_note: Presenter line on the DHA-authored DHITS 2026 Transforming Medical Acquisition deck (August 11-13, 2026; in MMT's DHITS library at /premium/dhits-2026): "Mr. Brett Scheideman, Acting Principal Deputy, Research, Development, and Acquisition/Deputy Component Acquisition Executive". The DHA Director leadership message of 21 SEP 2026 named RDML Ivonne Arena Principal Deputy; Mary Womack set that line aside on 2026-11-08 and MMT carries the August deck titles until a public posting settles the seat.

people.name: Rear Adm. Ivonne Arena
people.title: Former Acting AD-RDA / Component Acquisition Executive; current seat not publicly posted
people.scope: Held AD-RDA/CAE in an acting capacity from IOC (20 APR 2026) through DHITS 2026 (August) until Dr. Matthew G. Clark was named CAE on 21 SEP 2026. Former DHA Deputy CIO. A move to TRICARE Health Plan is reported in Mary's OWHA territory map; no new title is posted and her dha.mil bio still reads Acting AD-RDA/CAE.
people.why_watch: She ran the acquisition shop through the reorg, so she carries how the three portfolio acquisition executives were actually built. If the TRICARE move is real, she becomes a beneficiary-engagement contact rather than an acquisition one.
people.verification_note: DHITS 2026 presenter line and recording (August 11-13, 2026; in MMT's DHITS library): Acting Assistant Director for Research, Development & Acquisition / Component Acquisition Executive. Reported TRICARE move from the OWHA territory map Mary provided 2026-11-08; pending official confirmation. The 21 SEP 2026 Director message named her Principal Deputy AD-RDA/CAE; set aside per Mary, 2026-11-08.

people.name: Mr. James Perkins
people.title: Portfolio Acquisition Executive, Medical Digital Solutions (PAE MDS) — Confirmed; the seat succeeding PEO DHMS
people.scope: MHS GENESIS, JOMIS, EIDS. PAE MDS absorbs the PEO DHMS and PEO Medical Systems portfolios at FOC. EHR portfolio acquisition reporting runs directly to USD(A&S). Oversees the HCDS recompete (award target July 2026).
people.why_watch: Confirmed in his PAE seat (Portfolio Acquisition Executive, Medical Digital Solutions) in 2026, after the June 9 All Hands — filling the PAE MDS assignment the deck still listed as open. Owns the largest DHA software portfolio, so the HCDS recompete and Oracle/Cerner interoperability are the watch items.
people.verification_note: Not listed on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page (which stops at the Assistant Directors). Source is the AD-RDA All Hands 09 JUN 2026 deck and the July 2026 confirmations. Last confirmed 2026-09-25.

people.name: Ms. Caitlyn Felkoski
people.title: Acting Portfolio Acquisition Executive, Medical Products (NH-IV)
people.scope: Medical devices, equipment, warfighter readiness/expeditionary medicine, simulation & training. Stands up at IOC.
people.why_watch: One of three new PAEs replacing the PEO Medical Systems construct. Owns medical-products and devices buys.
people.verification_note: Not listed on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page. Source is the AD-RDA All Hands 09 JUN 2026 deck. Last confirmed 2026-09-25.

people.name: Mrs. Madeleine Friedman
people.title: Acting Portfolio Acquisition Executive, Medical Services
people.scope: Enterprise medical services, reserve health readiness, virtual health, TRICARE acquisition cell, Acquisition of Services Center of Excellence. Stands up at IOC.
people.why_watch: Services-side PAE. TRICARE and reserve-health services acquisitions route here.
people.verification_note: Not listed on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page. Source is the AD-RDA All Hands 09 JUN 2026 deck. Last confirmed 2026-09-25.

people.name: Mr. James Watkins
people.title: Director, DHA Contracting Activity (DHACA)
people.scope: Executes contract awards across the DHA enterprise. Receives USAHCA/USAMHCA workload and staff transition by FOC.
people.why_watch: Every DHA award flows through DHACA. Expect workload and staffing pressure as USAHCA folds in by FOC.
people.verification_note: Not listed on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page. Source is the AD-RDA All Hands 09 JUN 2026 deck. Last confirmed 2026-09-25.

people.name: Brig. Gen. Constance L. Jenkins
people.title: Commander, DHA Research & Development / Medical Research & Development Command (MRDC); Director of Research & Development, DHA
people.scope: DHA R&D enterprise after the Army-to-DHA transfer. Direct report under AD-RDA. Assumed command 10 July 2026, succeeding Maj. Gen. Paula Lodi.
people.why_watch: FY2027 RDTE down ~59% vs FY2026 enacted. Research-to-acquisition 'valley of death' is the strategic risk; TATRC/MRDC future under review.
people.verification_note: Not listed on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page. Source is the DHA R&D-MRDC change of command, 10 JUL 2026. Last confirmed 2026-09-25.

people.name: Mr. Michael Emerson
people.title: Assistant Director, Support, Personnel & Financial Operations
people.scope: AD-SPFO — comptroller, personnel, contracting support functions.
people.why_watch: Owns the financial machinery behind every DHA buy. Budget execution lives here.
people.verification_note: Listed on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page as Assistant Director, Support, Personnel, & Financial Operations, read 2026-10-19.

people.name: Brig. Gen. Jason Lennen
people.title: Director, Office of Warfighter Health Advantage (OWHA)
people.scope: Leads OWHA, created in the April 2026 reorg, which consolidated the former DIG, CDAO, BID, Digital Health Integration Office and SIG functions: data, analytics, AI and machine learning, and digital health. Came from the Air Force Surgeon General's office, where he was Director of Policy and Resources. His own LinkedIn profile (read in research dated 2026-11-08) shows a Deputy Assistant Director, Support, Personnel and Financial Operations stint at DHA from August to September 2026 before the OWHA seat, which it dates to October 2026. Succeeds Rear Adm. Tracy Farrill. Not reflected on dha.mil as of 2026-11-08; pending official confirmation.
people.why_watch: The DHA Director describes OWHA as setting strategy and determining what technologies and tools execute it, so this office frames the requirement before acquisition sees it. A policy, resources and personnel background points at funding lines, workforce readiness and requirements rather than tooling. His Executive Officer is Jillian Kozub (LinkedIn, pending official confirmation).
people.verification_note: DHA Director leadership message "Key DHA HQ Personnel Updates", VADM Darin K. Via, 21 SEP 2026 (milsuite Leadership Messages; not a public link). Provided to MMT by Mary Womack. His af.mil biography confirms the Air Force seat he leaves (Director of Policy and Resources, Office of the Surgeon General). The SPFO deputy stint and the October 2026 OWHA start are from his LinkedIn profile (https://www.linkedin.com/in/jason-lennen-a87452230) as reported in research Mary provided 2026-11-08; MMT did not reach the page. No dha.mil page places him at OWHA yet.

people.name: Rear Adm. Tracy Farrill
people.title: Retiring; former Director, Office of Warfighter Health Advantage (OWHA)
people.scope: Stood up and led OWHA from the April 2026 reorg. The DHA Director announced on 21 SEP 2026 that she is retiring after 34 years of service, crediting roughly seven years at DHA on digital health integration and organizational and innovation work. No public retirement notice as of 2026-09-25; DHA's 14 AUG 2026 article still lists her as OWHA director.
people.why_watch: If your digital health or AI relationship at DHA ran through her, it now runs through Brig. Gen. Jason Lennen. Re-introduce before the next requirement cycle.
people.verification_note: DHA Director leadership message "Key DHA HQ Personnel Updates", VADM Darin K. Via, 21 SEP 2026 (milsuite Leadership Messages; not a public link). Provided to MMT by Mary Womack. MMT does not characterize her service branch: public sources are inconsistent about whether she is U.S. Public Health Service Commissioned Corps or Navy.

people.name: Dr. Jesus Caban
people.title: Chief Data and Artificial Intelligence Officer (CDAO); inside OWHA
people.scope: Runs the DHA Chief Data and Artificial Intelligence Office, the office that consolidated into OWHA in the April 2026 reorg. The dha.mil CDAO page describes him as principal advisor to the DHA Deputy Director on data and AI. Launched the DHA Data and Innovation Strategy in March 2026.
people.why_watch: Data governance gate for any data-platform, analytics or AI deal at DHA. His office publishes the Authoritative Data Source designations and the strategy that every DHA data buy will be scored against. Junayd Park leads Application Prototyping and Integration for AI under him (dha.mil CDAO page), the fastest route to a prototype.
people.verification_note: Named on the dha.mil CDAO page (https://dha.mil/Offices-and-Programs/CDAO), the same page MMT cited for him on 2026-11-03 in "The desk after the clinic". Research Mary provided 2026-11-08 reads the same page for the principal-advisor language and for Junayd Park's title; the page was not reachable from the session that applied this entry, so treat the page read date as 2026-11-03.

people.name: CDR John de Geus, MD, USN
people.title: Information and Innovation Lead, OWHA
people.scope: OWHA Information and Innovation Lead: the innovation intake and the Innovation Engine (Scout, Build, Buy) of the Advantage Engine. The DHITS 2026 "Fail Fast, Field Faster" deck proposes OWHA as a standing test-and-fail cell using OTAs and CSOs, with the ARMOR initiative (workforce, qualification and medical-clearance data through 90-day prototypes) as the example. Navy Medical Corps commander and former Navy Chief Medical Informatics Officer; OrangeSlices AI reported him joining DHA as a Senior Advisor in February 2026. Holds the innovation function the former Digital Integration Group performed; the DIG name did not carry over. Division and branch chiefs under him are not publicly named.
people.why_watch: The innovation front door inside OWHA. An AI-agent, readiness-data or clinical-informatics pilot that wants an OWHA sponsor starts here, with the CDAO as the data gate and the WMSIB as the funding gate. ARMOR sits in this pipeline.
people.verification_note: Presenter lines on two DHA-authored DHITS 2026 decks (August 11-13, 2026; in MMT's DHITS library at /premium/dhits-2026): "CDR John de Geus, MD, DHA Office of Warfighter Health Advantage, Information & Innovation Lead" (Advantage Engine) and "CDR John de Geus, MD, OWHA" (Fail Fast, Field Faster). Background from his LinkedIn profile (https://www.linkedin.com/in/john-de-geus-9914867b) and OrangeSlices AI (https://orangeslices.ai/nacy-cmio-john-de-geus-joins-dha-as-senior-advisor/), as reported in research Mary provided 2026-11-08. Not yet on a dha.mil page.

people.name: Ms. Dawn Herman
people.title: Chief, Readiness, Strategy and Business Innovation (Data and Analytics)
people.scope: Presented the DHITS 2026 "Enterprise Dashboards for Real-Time Decision-Making" session with Beatrice Collazo (Lead, Analytics and Insights). The deck credits both to DHA; Mary's territory map places them in OWHA's Data and Analytics line under the CDAO. The session documents dashboard sprawl (10,000 BITAB/Tableau workbooks and 23,000 MED365 Power Platform assets as of April 2026) and a 0 to 100 value assessment that drives keep, consolidate or retire decisions. The map also credits the team with two workforce tools, the Total Workforce Management Tool and the Integrated Manpower and Personnel Resourcing Tool; those names are not in the deck text MMT holds.
people.why_watch: Any new dashboard or analytics product at DHA gets scored against the consolidation review her team runs. Workforce-readiness and manpower analytics (the ground ARMOR covers) start here.
people.verification_note: Presenter line on the DHA-authored DHITS 2026 Enterprise Dashboards deck (August 11-13, 2026; in MMT's DHITS library at /premium/dhits-2026): "Ms. Dawn Herman, Chief, Readiness, Strategy, & Business Innovation, DHA". OWHA placement and the TWMT and IMPRT tool names come from the OWHA territory map Mary provided 2026-11-08 and are pending official confirmation.

people.name: Mr. Matthew Motley
people.title: Performance to Plan (P2P) Lead, OWHA
people.scope: OWHA Performance to Plan lead, the execution-tracking function: the Performance Engine that cascades the Campaign Plan and four Lines of Effort into KPI boards and tiered huddles. Came from DHA Strategic Integration Group (SIG), where he was Chief, Strategy Management, not the Business Integration Division. In seat since August 2026 per OrangeSlices AI.
people.why_watch: Owns the performance dashboards OWHA reports against, including the access dashboard OWHA owed on 31 OCT 2026 under the FY2027 operational framework. Execution tracking and reporting tools land here.
people.verification_note: Presenter line on the DHA-authored DHITS 2026 "Advantage Engine" deck (August 11-13, 2026; in MMT's DHITS library at /premium/dhits-2026): "Mr. Matthew Motley, DHA Office of Warfighter Health Advantage, Performance to Plan Lead". Start date and SIG background from OrangeSlices AI (07 AUG 2026) and his LinkedIn profile (https://www.linkedin.com/in/matt-motley1988), as reported in research Mary provided 2026-11-08. Not yet on a dha.mil page.

people.name: Mr. Erick Vines
people.title: Chief, Business Integration Division (BID) (reported)
people.scope: Reported as BID Chief since January 2024, with Tari Rangel as Deputy Chief. BID covers purchased-care recapture and health-services delivery planning. Both LinkedIn profiles still place BID under J-8 Financial Management; the April 2026 reorg slide lists BID among the functions consolidated into OWHA. MMT carries BID's placement as unresolved.
people.why_watch: If BID sits in OWHA, purchased-care recapture analytics report to the same director as the CDAO. If it stayed in J-8, the buyer for that work is AD-SPFO. Mary's territory map reads the 20 APR 2026 chart as moving BID's divisions into OWHA; the LinkedIn titles still say J-8. Confirm the reporting line before building a capture plan around it.
people.verification_note: LinkedIn profiles of Erick Vines (https://www.linkedin.com/in/erick-vines-97886280) and Tari Rangel (https://www.linkedin.com/in/tari-rangel-74ab6a66), as reported in research Mary provided 2026-11-08. LinkedIn only; no dha.mil page names either seat or BID's current parent. Pending official confirmation.

people.name: Lt Col Zachary Sonnier
people.title: Chief Health Informatics Officer (reported)
people.scope: Presented at DHITS 2026 (August) as Deputy Chief Health Informatics Officer, DHA, on the MHS ambient-listening pilot. Reported as Chief Health Informatics Officer, Health Informatics and Digital Integration (HIDI), OWHA by September 2026 (OrangeSlices AI; FEHRM Annual Summit program per Mary's territory map). HIDI is the successor to the Digital Health Integration Office; its division head is not publicly named.
people.why_watch: Clinical informatics and MHS GENESIS integration requirements route through the CHIO. Pair with HIDI when the chief is named.
people.verification_note: Deputy CHIO: presenter line on the DHA-authored DHITS 2026 ambient-listening pilot deck (August 11-13, 2026; in MMT's DHITS library). CHIO: OrangeSlices AI, "DHA taps Zachary Sonnier to be Chief Health Informatics Officer" (https://orangeslices.ai/dha-taps-zachary-sonnier-to-be-chief-health-informatics-officer/) and the FEHRM Annual Summit 2026 program, as reported in research and the OWHA territory map Mary provided 2026-11-08; neither reached by MMT. The CHIO title is pending official confirmation.

people.name: Ms. Christine Sordillo
people.title: Deputy Senior Procurement Executive (reported)
people.scope: Reported as DHA's Deputy Senior Procurement Executive since October 2026 after serving as OWHA's Strategic Acquisition Advisor, the title on her DHITS 2026 "Fail Fast, Field Faster" presenter line (August 2026). Where the seat sits relative to DHACA and the Component Acquisition Executive is not published.
people.why_watch: She carried OWHA's requirements into acquisition and now sits on the procurement policy side. A useful read on how OWHA-framed requirements get bought.
people.verification_note: Strategic Acquisition Advisor: presenter line on the DHA-authored DHITS 2026 "Fail Fast, Field Faster" deck (in MMT's DHITS library). Deputy Senior Procurement Executive: her LinkedIn profile (https://www.linkedin.com/in/christine-sordillo), as reported in research Mary provided 2026-11-08. LinkedIn only for the new seat; no dha.mil page names it. Pending official confirmation.

people.name: Mr. Pat Flanders
people.title: Chief Information Officer (J-6) — Confirmed
people.scope: DHA enterprise IT and the J-6 Chief Information Office. J-6 transitions under AD-SPFO at FOC (19 July 2026).
people.why_watch: Confirmed as the DHA CIO after the June 9, 2026 All Hands. Owns the enterprise IT and cyber layer beneath MHS GENESIS and the DHMS portfolio; the J-6 CIO shop is a required stop for infrastructure, hosting, and cybersecurity requirements.
people.verification_note: Not listed on the dha.mil Organizational Structure page. Source is the July 2026 confirmation after the 09 JUN 2026 All Hands and the DHITS 2026 J-6 panel. Last confirmed 2026-09-25.

people.name: Col. Valerie Sams
people.title: Chief, Joint Trauma System (JTS)
people.scope: Leads the Joint Trauma System, a DHA subordinate activity carried under J-7 Education and Training on MMT's chart. Succeeds Army Col. (Dr.) Jennifer M. Gurney. Air Force trauma surgeon and ECMO physician; Director of the Center for Sustainment of Trauma and Readiness Skills in Cincinnati and Critical Care Air Transport Team training cadre.
people.why_watch: JTS drives joint trauma clinical standards, which the DHA Director frames as elevating battlefield medicine. A new chief is a clinical requirements signal for trauma data, registry work and en route care.
people.verification_note: Defense Visual Information Distribution Service release, 20 SEP 2026: https://www.dvidshub.net/news/574850/ready-today-learning-always-saving-lives-defense-health-agencys-joint-trauma-system-welcomes-new-chief-aligning-focus-deliver-joint Also carried in the DHA Director leadership message "Key DHA HQ Personnel Updates", VADM Darin K. Via, 21 SEP 2026 (milsuite Leadership Messages; not a public link). Provided to MMT by Mary Womack.

people.name: Rear Adm. Sara Newman
people.title: Director, DHA-Public Health
people.scope: Leads DHA Public Health, one of the healthcare operations directorates under AD-HCAO. Took the directorate in July 2026. The DHA Director reported her promotion to Rear Adm. on 21 SEP 2026; DHA's own 30 JUL 2026 article still renders her as U.S. Public Health Service Capt. MMT carries the promotion as reported and pending official confirmation.
people.why_watch: Public health carries surveillance, environmental health and disease control requirements under Healthcare Administration and Operations. A promotion in seat reads as continuity in that portfolio, not a change of direction.
people.verification_note: DHA Director leadership message "Key DHA HQ Personnel Updates", VADM Darin K. Via, 21 SEP 2026 (milsuite Leadership Messages; not a public link). Provided to MMT by Mary Womack. Role and background confirmed by DHA, 30 JUL 2026: https://dha.mil/News/2026/07/30/13/12/Fitness-family-connection which renders her rank as Capt., U.S. Public Health Service. The flag-rank promotion has no public source as of 2026-09-25.

people.name: Mr. Dan Gall
people.title: Director, TRICARE Health Plan (reported)
people.scope: Reported as Director, TRICARE Health Plan since July 2026, with Curt Prichard as Deputy Director. Dr. David Krulak, the previous Director, left in May 2026 and is now at the VA Office of Inspector General per his biography there. TRICARE Health Plan sits under AD-HCAO.
people.why_watch: The beneficiary-facing buyer. Contact center, CRM and engagement use cases land here. The FY27 Campaign Order's fourth line of effort targets 90% inpatient and outpatient satisfaction and every specialty patient seen within 28 days, which is this office's scorecard.
people.verification_note: LinkedIn profiles of Dan Gall and Curt Prichard and the VA OIG biography of David Krulak, as reported in the OWHA territory map Mary provided 2026-11-08; none reached from the session. No dha.mil page names the seat. Pending official confirmation.

agencies.agency_name: Office of the Assistant Secretary of War for Health Affairs (ASW(HA))
agencies.note: Office renamed from ASD(HA) to ASW(HA) following the Department of War rename. ASW(HA) reports through OUSD(P&R) to the Secretary of War. The health.mil Biographies page (Last Updated August 13, 2026) was read 2026-10-19 and lists every person in this block.

people.name: Hon. Keith Bass
people.title: Assistant Secretary of War for Health Affairs (ASW(HA))
people.scope: Civilian head of the Military Health System. Policy and oversight of DHA and the Service medical departments.
people.why_watch: ASW(HA) sets MHS policy direction. Bass's priorities shape what DHA actually buys.
people.verification_note: Listed on the health.mil Biographies page (Last Updated 2026-08-13), read 2026-10-19. Earlier: in seat at the 2026 Military Health System Research Symposium, 2026-08-03: https://health.mil/News/Dvids-Articles/2026/08/03/news571397

people.name: Dr. Vincent Lee Ball
people.title: Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Health Affairs
people.scope: Day-to-day ASW(HA) operations; acts when Bass is out. Succeeds Dr. Stephen Ferrara, who no longer appears on the health.mil Biographies page. Retired Army lieutenant colonel; former Special Forces team commander and emergency physician (Madigan Army Medical Center, Arbor Health Critical Access Hospital).
people.why_watch: Often the actual signature on policy memos and budget guidance to DHA. A new principal deputy means the working relationship under Bass resets; if your office-level contact was Ferrara, re-introduce.
people.verification_note: Listed on the health.mil Biographies page (Last Updated 2026-08-13), read 2026-10-19; bio at https://www.health.mil/About-MHS/Biographies/Dr-Vincent-Lee-Ball (no start date given). Ferrara's last public confirmation was 2026-01-12 (https://www.health.mil/News/Videos/2026/01/12/Ferrara-Interview); no departure announcement found. Start date pending official confirmation.

people.name: Ms. Susan Orsega
people.title: Deputy Assistant Secretary of War, Health Services Policy and Oversight
people.scope: Health services policy, TRICARE-related oversight, MHS quality.
people.why_watch: Owns the policy lens on TRICARE T-5 execution and managed-care contractor performance.
people.verification_note: Listed on the health.mil Biographies page (Last Updated 2026-08-13), read 2026-10-19. Earlier confirmation 2026-03-10 at a DoW civilian health pilot session.

people.name: Mr. Darrell Landreaux
people.title: Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Health Resources Management and Policy
people.scope: Health resources management, including budget formulation across the MHS.
people.why_watch: Where the Defense Health Program (DHP) budget guidance lands before flowing to DHA.
people.verification_note: Listed on the health.mil Biographies page (Last Updated 2026-08-13), read 2026-10-19; bio https://health.mil/About-MHS/Biographies/Darrell-Landreaux. Still no dated corroboration beyond the official roster.

people.name: Terry M. Rauch, Ph.D., MPH, MBA
people.title: Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Health Readiness Policy and Oversight
people.scope: Health readiness policy — operational medicine, deployable systems.
people.why_watch: JOMIS and operational health IT priorities flow through this office.
people.verification_note: Listed as Acting on the health.mil Biographies page (Last Updated 2026-08-13), read 2026-10-19. Earlier: still acting at the DoW sleep and fatigue management convening, June 2026: https://cdp.usuhs.edu/blog/highlights-2026-sleep-and-fatigue-management-dow-convening. The permanent seat was posted on USAJOBS, so the acting status is live and likely to move.

agencies.note: Each Service medical department retains its own leadership and partial budget authority for Service-specific medical systems and personnel. The health.mil Biographies page (Last Updated August 13, 2026) was read 2026-10-19 and lists every person in this block.

people.name: Lt. Gen. Mary K. Izaguirre

people.name: Rear Adm. Matthew Case
people.title: Acting Surgeon General of the Navy; Acting Chief, Bureau of Medicine and Surgery
people.scope: Leads Navy Medicine as the acting surgeon general and acting BUMED chief. Succeeded Rear Adm. Rick Freedman, who retired 2026-06-26 after 35 years. Rear Adm. Kevin J. Brown, Commander of Naval Medical Forces Pacific, was nominated for the permanent seat (PN1278, 119th Congress, received 2026-09-14) and placed on the Senate Executive Calendar on 2026-09-23 (Calendar No. 937); not confirmed as of 2026-10-19.
people.why_watch: The Navy surgeon general seat is acting and the nominee is on the Senate calendar, so Navy Medicine commitments made now may be revisited by a confirmed successor within weeks. If your Navy Medicine relationship ran through Rear Adm. Freedman, it ended in June.
people.verification_note: Listed as Acting Surgeon General of the Navy on the health.mil Biographies page (Last Updated 2026-08-13), read 2026-10-19. agencies.agency_name: Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H)
agencies.note: ARPA-H is HHS's high-risk biomedical R&D agency. Program managers run individual programs with significant autonomy. As of the Oct 19, 2026 read of the People page: Health Science Futures has a permanent Director (Gene Civillico) with Tyler Best as Deputy; Proactive Health lists 8 program managers; Scalable Solutions lists 8 program managers but no Director or Acting Director (Natalie Kates, Acting Director on Aug 25, no longer appears); Resilient Systems is not listed on the page at all. The Business Innovation Division Director seat, vacant and recruiting since April 2026, is now held by Catherine Stevens. The HHS HCA roster (content last reviewed 2026-04-27, re-read 2026-10-19) still names Deputy Director Benjamin Bryant as Acting Head of Contracting Activity; whether HCA authority has moved to Stevens is pending official confirmation.

people.why_watch: Listed on the ARPA-H People page as of Oct 5, 2026 and again Oct 19, 2026. Strategy seats shape which mission-office themes get the next solicitation cycle.

people.name: Gene Civillico
people.title: Director, Health Science Futures
people.scope: Mission office — high-risk basic-to-translational health science. Neurobiologist; joined ARPA-H in September 2026 from FDA's Center for Devices and Radiological Health, where he led neurotechnology regulatory science tools and review teams for breakthrough neuromodulation devices.
people.why_watch: One of four mission offices; programs span from foundational science to platform technology. A permanent director replaces the acting arrangement, so HSF program decisions now have a settled owner with a devices and neurotech background.
people.verification_note: Listed as Director, Health Science Futures on the ARPA-H People page, read 2026-10-19; bio at https://arpa-h.gov/about/people/gene-civillico (joined ARPA-H September 2026; no start date for the Director role given).

agencies.agency_name: Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration (Office of Veterans Community Care)
agencies.note: Community care is VA's largest purchased-care line and CCN Next Gen is its recompete. The Office of Veterans Community Care (VCC) sits inside VHA. This block holds the two VCC names MMT tracks: the office's new Deputy Assistant Under Secretary for Health and the Executive Director who runs the network recompete. Neither is on the VA Staff Biographies index snapshot of 2026-10-20 (that index covers Assistant Secretary level and above, so a DAUSH or Executive Director would not appear there), so both entries rest on their own announcements and stay pending official confirmation.

people.name: Alicia Skolrood
people.title: Deputy Assistant Under Secretary for Health for Veterans Community Care (VCC)
people.scope: Leads the Office of Veterans Community Care, the VHA program office over purchased care, including the CCN Next Gen recompete that Janet Cabeen runs. Joined VHA in 2024 after a career in healthcare middle and senior management (MBA, CPHQ). Her stated priorities: coordinated, high-quality care regardless of where it is delivered, a seamless and integrated system of care, and partnerships with providers, industry, Congress and Veterans.
people.why_watch: The senior executive over community care policy and the CCN Next Gen program office. Her quality-management background (CPHQ) and her 'seamless, integrated system of care' framing point to care coordination, TPA quality oversight and integration with direct care as the themes a community care bid or capability pitch has to answer.
people.verification_note: Named Deputy Assistant Under Secretary for Health for Veterans Community Care per her own public announcement, read Oct 22, 2026. Not on the VA Staff Biographies index snapshot of Oct 20, 2026, which covers Assistant Secretary level and above; pending official confirmation on a VA page. Start date and predecessor not stated in the announcement.

people.name: Janet Cabeen
people.title: Executive Director, Networks and Contracts Management, Office of Veterans Community Care (SES)
people.scope: Leads CCN Next Gen, the community care network recompete. Her stated plan: one purchasing structure for community care, Veterans Care Agreements and local healthcare contracts folded into the network, stronger Third Party Administrator (TPA) performance oversight, and Veteran and Family Member Programs (VFMP) run alongside community care.
people.why_watch: The program owner for the largest procurement in VA's history. Her stated priorities (TPA accountability, consolidated local contracting, VFMP alignment) are the evaluation themes a CCN Next Gen bid has to answer.
people.verification_note: Sworn into the SES as Executive Director, Networks and Contracts Management, per her own public announcement dated Oct 20, 2026. Not yet listed on the VA Staff Biographies index as of Oct 20, 2026; pending official confirmation on a VA page.

The nominee for the permanent seat, Gary Shatswell, had a Senate Veterans' Affairs Committee hearing in June 2026 and was not confirmed as of 2026-10-19 (no confirmation found).
